topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I can’t help but think about the忸怩 way I acted when I found out about Mr. Thompson’s secret fortune. It’s not like I’ve been peering over his fence or anything, just noticed some things. The sleek car parked discreetly, the subtle touches of elegance, the whispered conversations. I told myself I shouldn’t judge, that everyone has their reasons, but I still felt a pinch when I realized how much I must’ve jumped to conclusions. I hope I can find a way to approach him, maybe say something that doesn’t reveal I’ve been noticing. Knowing what I know now, I just wish I could turn back the clock a bit, handle things differently, be more understanding from the start.
